# decisionpaths

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

`decisionpaths` is an R package for analyzing **longitudinal decision pathways** in adaptive systems.  
It provides tools to represent sequences of decisions across time and compute diagnostic metrics describing how those decisions evolve.

The package implements the **Decision Infrastructure Paradigm** (Hait, 2025), allowing researchers to study how decision systems behave across repeated periods.

Core functionality includes:

• **Path descriptors** – summarize individual decision trajectories  
• **Decision Reliability Index (DRI)** – quantify stability of decisions over time  
• **Path entropy** – measure diversity of decision pathways  
• **Equity diagnostics** – compare decision exposure across groups  
• **Integrated audits** – generate system-level summaries of decision infrastructures

The package is designed for applications in:

- education policy and adaptive interventions  
- algorithmic decision systems  
- longitudinal treatment assignment  
- AI-assisted decision infrastructure

## Installation

You can install the development version from GitHub:

```r
install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("causalfragility-lab/decisionpaths")
library(decisionpaths)

dp <- dp_build(data, id, time, decision)

desc <- dp_describe(dp)
dri  <- dp_dri(dp)
ent  <- dp_entropy(dp)

plot(dp, type = "heatmap")
